stem.text: Which command shows the beads that are ready to work on?

data.boost: Think about the word you would use for work you can start now.

worked_solution: bd ready lists open beads that nothing blocks.
bd list shows every open bead, blocked or not.

stem.text: You are starting on Buy paint (`demo-xbx`) and want nobody else to take it. Which command?

worked_solution: Claiming marks a bead as yours and in progress.
bd update with --claim does both in one step.

stem.text: Paint the fence must wait until Buy paint is done. Which command records that?

data.boost: Which bead is the one that waits?

worked_solution: bd dep add takes the bead that waits first, then the bead it waits on.
Paint the fence (demo-2ma) waits on Buy paint (demo-xbx).
The answer is `bd dep add demo-2ma demo-xbx`.
